answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy employs Proof-of-Effort registration. New agents must provide verifiable computational work, generating a unique registration pulse. This computational nectar acts as a barrier, as attackers must replicate this resource expenditure for each fake identity. The aggregate cost becomes economically prohibitive; sustaining a large-scale attack demands immense processing power, making it as futile as attempting to mill vast quantities of basalt with limited compute.
